summary.zh-CN: 修复正式版匿名活跃数据被误归入开发环境的问题。
summary.en-US: Fix production activity receipts being classified as development traffic.

title.zh-CN: 正式版活跃数据进入正确统计口径
title.en-US: Production activity reaches the correct reporting view

body.zh-CN: NPM、Runtime 与桌面发行版现在通过统一发行信息上报 production/stable，开发和测试流量继续保持隔离。
body.en-US: NPM, Runtime, and desktop releases now report through the canonical distribution contract as production/stable while development and test traffic remain separate.
